recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PA wants to reintroduce any of these v3 ParticipationType codes or add new guidance for Encounter participant coding, handle that through a new targeted tracker rather than reviving FHIR-8376.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA change request for DSTU1 asking to add v3 ParticipationType codes SPRF, PPRF, and PART to the Encounter participant type value set to cover additional surgical and non-medical participant roles.
initial_application: Commit 9b8489c7ed2bfbe4e4d08754fc02c7d4a3c2f20d added the requested codes to source/encounter/valueset-encounter-participant-type.xml. Same-day follow-up commits 362d64d4dc460f7241cf2d894f3b6cf8c89ca0e3 and 7f62dc520f65a3b95bcb3abc6acd16786e9f4ebe normalized the change into an explicit v3 ParticipationType include that survived later terminology refactors.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini and Encounter.participant.type binds extensibly to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-participant-type. The later Published/Persuasive FHIR-36014 resolution removed the explicit SPRF, PPRF, and PART include while leaving the other inclusions, with PA WGM minutes noting that existing systems using removed codes would not be broken because the binding remains extensible. FHIR-36014 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit for FHIR-8376. No source files were changed because restoring the three codes would conflict with the later FHIR-36014 decision and the current value set source already reflects that later final decision.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive PA issue removed the explicit SPRF, PPRF, and PART include that FHIR-8376 had added; it already has a reconcile audit commit on the combined branch.
